title: Started guitar at 19-20; Red Allen in short pants at the Corporate Hall
summary: Bocage began guitar around 19 or 20; he recalls a night at the Corporate Hall where the boy trumpeter Red Allen amazed the crowd.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up a first guitar or banjo, self-taught

blocks.x: Oh, I was young. I was around about 19, 20 years old, something like that.
How old were you before you stopped wearing knickers and put on long pants in those days?
How long was I playing before I put on long pants?
Oh, well, I had on long pants. Yeah, you had on long pants.
When Red Island did, he had on low short pants.

Because one night, we played at the Corporate's Hall. And when they asked where the trumpet player was, I told him, I said, there he is. So the man said, I hide no cheering down here, you know. So I said, you're already playing. Wait till you start playing. So at that time, I started playing. At 10 o'clock, the hall was cracked down. So he asked me, he said, where you got that boy from? I said, that boy came from across the river. You know, I said, well, let me go out there. I can't be playing some trumpet up there. Well, at that time, we was playing at the Corporate's. And Sam Morgan and them was playing around at Sound of Silver. Well, we closed them up. So they came around about 10 o'clock, and they sat in. They came around and sat in for a while with us, and they played a couple of numbers, you see. They had a fellow go around and they sat in like that, you know.
